long_biography.plain_text:
Nidal Ghazi Karameh redirected Mikano from importing and servicing generators towards local assembly in Nigeria. Known publicly as Mofid Karameh, he had trained as a mechanical engineer before establishing the company around power equipment. The assembly line turned technical-service experience into a Nigerian manufacturing platform with in-country production and technical capability.

Karameh widened Mikano through steel fabrication, electrical systems, vehicle assembly, construction, food production, medical equipment and additional industrial services. He remains the group's chairman and chief executive. Mikano's Afrimedical division later entered healthcare manufacturing through a rapid-diagnostics production partnership with Abbott.
